title: Shared definitions of the chronolex configuration v0.3.0
description: Not a document: definitions that the other chronolex schemas refer to (common.json#/definitions/<name>), such as an identifier, a legal basis and a synthesis source.

lexostatus_name.description: The name of a lexostatus: a name from lexostatuses.yaml, or the reading article of a lexostatus from the law (<regulation>#<article>, optionally with ' lid <n>').

source.description: A lexostatus of a cell. Without url, the transport is internal: the cell runs in the same runtime. With url, the query goes over HTTP to <url>/cells/<cell>/api/lexostatus/<lexostatus>. With case: true, it is a lexostatus of the case itself, in the cell in which the process records, with root as its only input: the decision queries it with the root and takes over all its parameters and extra fields. Such a source names no input, parameters or extra fields.

regulation.description: Instead of cell: the consumer's own policy, computed by the engine (note on source and gram id). lexostatus is then the article (<regulation>#<article>), input are the parameters and extra_fields the outputs; a register that queries that policy is provided by the deployment (CELL_REGISTERS).

case.description: A lexostatus of the case itself (see above).

input.description: Per input of the source lexostatus: which field the value comes from (lexostatus and field), or a fixed value (value). A field comes from a lexostatus of the case (for the assessment: the assessment lexostatus; a parameter or an extra field), or from the response of an earlier source in the list that passes that field on under extra_fields; that source may itself wait for an earlier source.

value.description: A fixed value, such as the body whose register is queried.

extra_fields.description: Extra fields from this source's response that are not parameters but input for a later source in the list (for example a name for a registration number). They do not go to the engine.

parameters.description: The parameters this source supplies, explicitly and without wildcards: a list if the source supplies them under the same name, or, per name at the source, the name at the consumer. Each name at the consumer is a parameter of an article under the assessment, the decision or the offer, and comes from only one source. May be empty only if the source passes on extra_fields.

oneOf.description: Per name the source supplies: the parameter name under which the consumer asks for the fact. The source speaks the language of its own law and supplies the name as a parameter or as an extra field; the translation to the consumer's parameters belongs with the consumer (synthesis at the consumer).

legal_basis.description: What the translation of this source rests on: the articles that ask for the fact at the consumer under its name and have the source supply it, and that carry a fixed value in the input (such as which body's register). On startup: every article is loaded and the paragraph (lid) exists. With origin_check: strict, every source that translates (a name at the consumer that differs from the name at the source, or a fixed value) has a legal_basis.

rows.description: Per-row synthesis: for each row of a table field, the process queries sources with values from that row, and the columns together form an array parameter. This way the actor fills the columns it determines itself, without putting them in code.

parameter.description: The array parameter that the rows together form.

table.description: The table field that supplies the rows: a lexostatus of the case, or a source that passes the field on, and the name under which it supplies the table (a parameter or an extra field).

columns.description: Per column of the table: the name under which it goes into the parameter. A column not listed here is left out.

sources.description: Sources queried per row, in order: a source can use a column that an earlier source supplied.

input.description: Per input of the source: the value from the row (column), from a lexostatus of the case or a source that passes the field on (lexostatus and field), from the merged parameters (parameter), an output of a regulation computed with the merged parameters (regulation and output; this is how the law derives an input, such as a reference date), or a fixed value (value).

columns.description: Per name the source supplies (a parameter or an extra field): the column name under which it goes into the row.

legal_basis.description: What the translation of this source rests on, as for a synthesis source: a column named differently at the consumer than at the source, or a fixed value in the input. With origin_check: strict, required as soon as the source translates.
